stemMd: Which change would most directly reduce oxygen diffusion from alveoli into blood if all other conditions remained constant?

options.label: B
options.textMd: An increase in the thickness of the alveolar-capillary barrier

options.label: E
options.textMd: An increase in exchange surface area

explanationMd: Diffusion is favoured by a large area, a large gradient and a short distance. Thickening the barrier increases distance and therefore slows oxygen transfer at otherwise equal conditions.

distractorRationale.c: This generally increases functional exchange area.
